name: floppydash
title: floppydash
blurb: diner-dash but it's a brick-and-mortar website shop: coders in the back write HTML orders onto floppy disks, you run them out to customers before their patience (and the shop's rating) hits zero. requested by @thebadcode.com, riffing on @anna.germnetwork.com's "they make you a website on the spot" idea.
